name: GLANCEvault
description: Optional self-hosted backend for the GLANCE apps (dayGLANCE, lastGLANCE, lifeGLANCE): zero-knowledge sync, cross-device intents and media storage. API-only service with no web interface.

app_vars.name: var_allowed_origins
app_vars.label: Allowed Browser Origins (CORS)
app_vars.help: Comma-separated origins allowed to call the API from a browser, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:6767,https://dayglance.app,app://dayglance,https://appassets.androidplatform.net. The Android app always uses the appassets origin and requires the vault behind HTTPS. '*' allows any origin; the device token still protects every request.

notes.text: API-only: verify the installation at http://IP:8080/healthz. There is no web interface.
The device token shown at the end of the install (also in /opt/glance-vault/.env) must be entered in each GLANCE app's sync settings.

Browser clients (e.g. the dayGLANCE web app or desktop app) may connect from any origin by default; narrow GLANCEVAULT_ALLOWED_ORIGINS in /opt/glance-vault/.env to your app origins (include app://dayglance for the desktop app) and restart the service.
Put a reverse proxy with TLS in front of the API for anything beyond LAN use; the /events endpoint must not be buffered by the proxy.
